verdicts.title: Rank-2 attractors and Deligne's conjecture
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we will study the arithmetic geometry of rank-2 attractors, which are Calabi-Yau threefolds whose Hodge structures admit interesting splits. verdicts.title: Uniform bounds for the number of rational points on curves of small Mordell--Weil rank
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $X$ be a curve of genus $g\geq 2$ over a number field $F$ of degree $d = [F:Q]$. verdicts.title: Rational points on modular curves via maps to elliptic curves with rank zero
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A fundamental problem in arithmetic geometry is to determine the image of the mod $N$ Galois representation for all elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}$ and integers $N \geq 1$.
